name: phomueangtai-enterprise
description: Phomueangtai personal multi-tool Discord bot and owner dashboard

scripts.check: npm run check:all && npm run check:dashboard:all
scripts.check:dashboard:all: cd dashboard-public && find . -path './node_modules' -prune -o -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.test: npm run test:discord && npm --prefix dashboard-public test
